input: 440x440 RGB bilinear resize, ImageNet normalization; native official validation transform
optimization: AdamW backbone1e-5/classifier1e-3, weight_decay1e-4; supervised contrastive temperature0.1 +0.25cosine classifier crossentropy temperature0.1; gradient norm cap5
updated_parameters: Full backbone, GeM, embedding BN affine; all BN running stats frozen
augmentation: Crop90–100%, restrained color, grayscale10%, quarter turns on Cows2021 only, no mirrored flank assumptions
selection: Select unchanged baseline or checkpoint by correct validation accepts under99%precision/1%unknownFA, then rank1; only external identity/date-disjoint validation
